title: Kula Today
heading: Today
summary: Cloudbase is at its highest of the day and still edging up. Kula Ag had mostly sun over the last hour; cloud reaches all the way to the Summit. Upslope has run since about 08:30 at a light 3 mph, and thermals seem light. Trades are holding the shear line at Pukalani, with no trade air on the lower west slope.
